note: 27 measured regions: 16 exhibit rows (15 figure rows and one table row) and 11 exclusions. The paper prints 16 figure captions covering 15 numbers - Figure 11 appears twice - and not one table number: there is no 'Table N' anywhere in the file, which a full-text scan confirms. Fifteen of the 16 printed figure captions are measured; the missing one is Figure 1, which prints 'Figure 1: Map of the Border Between Forest and Farmland in Italy' under a satellite orthophoto on a sheet whose text layer, XObject list and drawing list are all empty, so it is declared a gap rather than given an invented bbox. Five sheets have that zero-text shape: p2 is the contents page, p3 carries the Introduction plus Figure 1, p6 carries '2 Model Preparation' and '2.2 Notations' ending in a two-part notation table that runs off the bottom edge, p11 is equations (13) to (17) with no exhibit at all, and p26 is the 'Report on Use of AI'. The p6 notation block is a second declared gap: two side-by-side uncaptioned sub-tables, unmeasurable for the same reason and unnumbered even on a page that could be read. The one table that IS measured is the parameter table on p7, which is also uncaptioned and unnumbered - the whole of sheet 7, split by the detector into two stacked regions and recorded as one row plus one fragment, with its 37 left-hand and 24 right-hand data rows, its italic section labels and its complete absence of rules, all read off the raster. Numbering defects, recorded as printed: Figure 11 is used twice with two different titles (p21 'Cost-Benefit Distribution Analysis', p24 'Sensitivity Analysis'), so the run 1-15 hides a collision and the last Figure 11 sits after Figures 12-15; p21 prints Figure 10's wrapped caption straight into Figure 11's caption so the text layer reads '... Performance AnalysisFigure 11: Cost-Benefit Distribution Analysis' on two lines; p22 prints Figure 12's number with a full-width colon while every other caption uses a half-width one; and in four places a figure's caption is printed at the foot of a page while the subsection heading it belongs to opens on the next or the same page below it - Figure 11's own heading 4.4.4 opens on p22, Figure 13's heading 4.4.6 prints below its caption, Figures 14 and 15's headings 4.4.7 and 4.4.8 print below their captions, and the second Figure 11's heading '5 Sensitivity Analysis' prints below its caption on p24. Panel structure: six of the 15 measured figure rows are 2x2 line grids with printed (a)-(d) letters - Figures 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 - and the second Figure 11 is a 2x2 grid with no letters at all. Figure 2 is a single uncaptioned-panel architecture composite in three named model blocks, and Figure 9 is the only plot in the paper with a colour bar - a 'Value Contribution' ramp from 0.60 to 0.95 - and the only one with values printed in every cell. No figure is three-dimensional. Ten watermark blocks are excluded (693 paths, bottom right, box 450-590 by 717-787) and the pink diagonal watermark text '微信公众号：数学模型' / '微信号：MATHmodels' lies across the art itself on p19, p20, p21, p22 and p23, including over Figure 6's and Figure 9's caption bands.
